common_issues.issue: Unicode em-dash (U+2014) used instead of ASCII double-hyphen
common_issues.details: All 6 sampled arcane files (arcane-magus-cadence, virtuos-fury, exodia-triumph, arcane-cleanse-grineer, arcane-aerial, arcane-truncate) used Unicode em-dashes in bullet list descriptions. STYLE.md requires ASCII only. Fixed in-place by replacing U+2014 with '--'.

common_issues.issue: slug field in frontmatter not present in arcaneSchema
common_issues.details: All 6 sampled arcane files had a 'slug:' key in frontmatter. The arcaneSchema (src/content/schemas/arcanes.ts) does not define a slug field. Astro derives the slug from the filename automatically. The extra field was removed from all 6 files.

common_issues.issue: Wrong H2 heading: 'Best on' should be 'Builds that use it'
common_issues.details: STYLE.md specifies the arcane page section order as: Overview, Effect, Stats per rank, Acquisition, Builds that use it, Notes. All 6 arcane files used 'Best on' instead. Renamed to 'Builds that use it' in all 6 files.

5 of 6 arcane files had insufficient body word counts: virtuos-fury (235), exodia-triumph (177), arcane-cleanse-grineer (178), arcane-aerial (195), arcane-truncate (188). arcane-magus-cadence was 283 (17 short). All 6 were rewritten with substantive content and now range from 575 to 626 words.

common_issues.issue: Sources section body was plain text instead of Markdown links
common_issues.details: All 6 arcane files had a '## Sources' section containing single plain-text lines like 'WFCD data accessed 2026-05-20; Fandom verification via Zariman mission pages.' instead of proper Markdown link syntax. STYLE.md requires Markdown link syntax. Fixed to use '- [Title](url)' format.

common_issues.issue: Wrong schema type: oro.mdx had type: 'weapon' instead of type: 'mode'
common_issues.details: oro.mdx described Oro as the scoring mechanic/resource in Conclave modes. The conclaveSchema enum is ['mode', 'weapon', 'syndicate-rank']. Oro is not a weapon -- it is used as the scoring object within Annihilation mode variants. Corrected to type: 'mode'.

common_issues.issue: Body word count marginally below 400-word floor
common_issues.details: chem-lab.mdx had 398 words, 2 short of the 400-word dojo floor. A substantive sentence about the need to complete the full research tree was added to the Purpose section, bringing the count to 422 words.

factual_accuracy_notes.finding: File says 'Gravemines' -- CORRECT. The audit brief incorrectly suggested 'Gravimag'; Gravimag is an arch-gun attachment item, not a Voidrig ability. Voidrig ability 3 is indeed Gravemines.
Meathook / Shield Maiden / Firing Line / Exalted Ironbride -- all correct per game canon.
'maximum of 10 members' -- CORRECT per game data (Ghost 1-10).
'maximum membership of 1000 players' -- CORRECT per game data (Moon 301-1000).
5 trees (Tactical, Gunnery, Piloting, Engineering, Command) each capping at rank 10 -- CORRECT.

Annihilation, Team Annihilation, Capture the Cephalon are real Conclave modes. Lunaro is correctly presented as a separate sport mode, not a combat mode. Oro is correctly described as a scoring mechanic within mode variants, not a standalone mode.
factual_accuracy_notes.action: No change required (other than type fix on oro.mdx).
